description: This file contains tests for the configuration-only channels status output, verifying how channel plugins and their configurations are displayed and distinguished based on their state (configured, unavailable, resolved). It includes setup functions for mock plugins and several test cases to validate status rendering.

methods.name: function registerSingleTestPlugin(pluginId: string, plugin: ChannelPlugin) { registerSingleTestPlugin
methods.description: Registers a single test plugin with a specified plugin ID and plugin object by updating the active plugin registry.

methods.name: async function formatLocalStatusSummary( formatLocalStatusSummary
methods.description: Formats the local channel configuration status summary for given configuration, returning a joined string of the status lines.

methods.name: function unresolvedTokenAccount() { unresolvedTokenAccount
methods.description: Returns a token account object indicating an unresolved or unavailable token.

methods.name: function tokenOnlyPluginConfig() { tokenOnlyPluginConfig
methods.description: Creates a plugin configuration for a token-only plugin with basic account listing and default functions.

methods.name: function makeUnavailableTokenPlugin(): ChannelPlugin { makeUnavailableTokenPlugin
methods.description: Creates a plugin instance representing a token plugin with unavailable token status.

methods.name: function makeResolvedTokenPlugin(): ChannelPlugin { makeResolvedTokenPlugin
methods.description: Creates a token plugin instance with resolved token details.

methods.name: function makeResolvedTokenPluginWithoutInspectAccount(): ChannelPlugin { makeResolvedTokenPluginWithoutInspectAccount
methods.description: Creates a token plugin instance where the inspectAccount method is missing, causing raw config resolution.

methods.name: function makeUnavailableHttpSlackPlugin(): ChannelPlugin { makeUnavailableHttpSlackPlugin
methods.description: Creates a Slack plugin with an unavailable signing secret.

methods.description: Helper to assert that the summary contains expected resolved token plugin details.
